text: Preserve every accepted requirement, public input/output, real product navigation, ten-product maximum, workbook writing operation/path and unconditional Browser cleanup. Review corrections to the existing implementation: inspectInitialSearchPage currently sends the complete raw snapshot to global interpretation. Both extraction tasks also take a whole snapshot rather than complete bounded independent pages and ask extraction to manufacture position/count/status/captcha labels. Use existing extract with explicit each over observationSnapshot.pages to compact every complete page to only observed facts needed by its consumer; each page may export observed candidate records, keeping ordering and exact URLs/references/actions. Keep metadata completeness checks on the original snapshot. Extract scripts may copy observed values, not invent indices, status labels or classification flags. Follow with explicit global interpretation of compact facts for consent/captcha decisions, first-ten selection and product field interpretation; do not pass the raw snapshot again. Keep each extraction target one result per page and no unrelated shared raw observations. Consent activation must choose an observed reference supporting activate, with explicit non-null guard (the separate availability boolean is not null proof); capture a fresh complete snapshot afterward. Both conditional branches must export the same explicit typed interface. Retain actual per-product visits and exact observed product fields; absent data remains explicit and cannot be fabricated. Keep final interpretation limited to compact rows and then perform the real document_write and preserve its returned filePath. Use only already inspected operations and existing TaskPlan forms; no scripts, limits changes, new public inputs or removal of business work.
